title: I Want to Be a Wall
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Yuriko, an asexual woman who loves boys' love stories, agrees to marry under pressure from her parents. Her husband, Gakurouta, is a gay man whose heart belongs to his oblivious childhood friend. Their marriage of convenience will never be a romance, but the two build a warm, unexpected partnership as they live together.
life_message: Love and family can take forms other than romance, built on honesty, companionship and acceptance.

content.note: Discussion of sexuality, boys' love fandom and unrequited same-sex love; no sexual content tagged; MangaDex safe.
